watch.summary: The creator humorously claims 100 Thieves intentionally let NRG win a round just to give them 'breathing room' before choking them out.

beats.what: Creator claims 100 Thieves deliberately gave NRG breathing room
Says they didn't want to choke them out too fast
Acts out seeing the lights in NRG's eyes fading and letting them breathe

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: We just let them get a little bit of breathing room, okay?
watch.why: The creator uses exaggerated banter to spin a lost esports round as a merciful strategic choice. Without context on the Valorant match and team rivalry, the humorous flex lands softly for casual viewers.
